import csv, hashlib, io, json, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

trial = Path('products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa')
report = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/editor-report-en-fr.md')
untouched = report.with_name('untouched-images.csv')
site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
runner, = trial.rglob('run_example.py')
raw = untouched.read_bytes()
lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), newline='')))
assert len(lines) == len(rows) + 1, 'This rehearsal requires one physical line per CSV record'
matches = [i for i, row in enumerate(rows) if row['style_id'] == 'SH-100' and row['url'].endswith('/sh-100/brown-5.jpg')]
assert len(matches) == 2 and matches[-1] == len(rows) - 1
first, repeat = (rows[i] for i in matches)
assert first == repeat and first['color'] == 'Brown' and first['position'] == '5'
edit = b''.join(lines[:-1])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    work = Path(directory)
    shutil.copy2(runner, work / runner.name)
    for name in ('transform.py', 'verify.py', 'verify_example.py'):
        shutil.copy2(site / name, work / name)
    shutil.copytree(site / 'fixtures', work / 'fixtures')
    (work / 'untouched-images.csv').write_bytes(raw)
    (work / 'editor-images.csv').write_bytes(edit)
    observations = {}
    for name in ('untouched-images.csv', 'editor-images.csv'):
        command = ['python3', 'run_example.py', '--images', name]
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        observations[name] = dict(argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)

out = Path('products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out / 'editor-images.csv').write_bytes(edit)
negative = observations['untouched-images.csv']
positive = observations['editor-images.csv']
evidence = dict(report_sha256=hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), runner_source=str(runner), support_source=str(site), matched_file_lines=[i + 2 for i in matches], removed_file_line=matches[-1] + 2, manual_work='Locate both rows and compare all parsed fields before removing the second occurrence.', observations=observations, negative_confirmed=negative['exit_code']==2 and 'style SH-100: same image URL used twice' in negative['stdout']+negative['stderr'], edited_exit_zero=positive['exit_code']==0, scope='Fictional offline rehearsal. Inspect the full positive output for the verifier checks and reference comparison before judging suitability.')
(out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False))
